text.tspan: Daily income of the poorest and richest decile, 1967 to 2021
Shown is the income or consumption at the cutoff to the poorest 10% and richest 10% in each country. This data is
adjusted for inflation and for differences in the cost of living between countries.
Source: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform
Note: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2017 prices. Depending on the country and year, the data relates to either income or
